page.layout: One printed title page: title block centred at top, then a verse passage beside a woodcut initial M, then the signature line centred below. No running head, page number or margin notes. Mirrored show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Nulli secundum magna quem tulit GANDA,
Cui semper instat, semper incubat mente,
Quam falsus error aut opinio veri,
Quis Te, beate, quis beatior spirat?
Cui tot laborum, gloriæque jam partæ,
Et veritatis, & sui, Polus Centrum est.

page.notes: The large initial M is a woodcut, read as M and joined to "Etator" to give "Metator". The verse lines are printed in italic and the line "Nunc major annis" begins with a decorative swash N. GANDA is in small capitals. Mirrored show-through of the imprint (Middelburgi, Apud Zachariam Romanum, M.DC.XVI, Cum Privilegio) and of a reverse title near the top right is excluded as not printed on this side.
